messages.text: Running a touch late, darling. Home by seven.
Shall I pick up something for supper?
Lovely. See you shortly, darling.
I've booked the table for Saturday. Eight o'clock.
Do take an umbrella, it's meant to pour.
Thinking of you, darling. Good luck today.
Train delayed again. Marvellous.
Goodnight, darling. Sleep well.
Ruth, are we still on for Sunday lunch?
Mum's birthday card is in the post. Do sign it when it arrives.
Happy to drive. I'll collect you at noon.
Glad to hear the operation went well. Rest up.
Cheers, Ruth. Speak soon.
Dear Dr. Okafor, thank you for your note. I shall review the figures and revert by Friday. Kind regards, Gerald
Apologies for the delay. Please find the revised schedule attached. Kind regards, Gerald
That works well for me. Tuesday at ten, then. Kind regards, Gerald
Could you clarify which version of the report you would like me to use? Kind regards, Gerald
Noted, and many thanks. Kind regards, Gerald
Pint on Thursday? Usual place.
Dreadful match. We were robbed.
Count me in. Cheers, G
Bit under the weather, rain check? Cheers, G
Ha. Very good. Cheers, G
Your round, I believe. Cheers, G

corrections.said: thanks i will get back to you
